title: Reduce GitHub Release CLI artifact size
description: The self-contained release artifact (eshyra-0p8u) is ~423 MB unpacked on linux-x64, dominated by the bundled @anthropic-ai Agent SDK (~255 MB, which vendors the Claude Code executable + platform binaries) and the pinned Node runtime (~118 MB). Investigate trimming: prune unused vendored binaries/locales from the Agent SDK bundle, drop dev-ish files from production deps, or compress more aggressively. Must not break the bundled-Node run path or the validation guards. Does not change the artifact format decision (eshyra-upef).
acceptance_criteria: A measured size reduction is achieved or a documented rationale explains why the bundle cannot shrink. The artifact still passes scripts/release/validate-release-artifact.mjs on all target platforms. No package private guard is touched and no npm publish metadata is added.
close_reason: Implemented release artifact pruning and stronger POSIX gzip compression. Local claude/linux-x64 measurement: unpacked 422,093,541 -> 397,120,692 bytes (25.0 MB saved); archive 133,423,934 -> 128,168,728 bytes (5.3 MB, 3.9% saved). Validated with npm run release:validate on rebuilt artifact; repo gates passed: npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test.
